components.title: Action band
components.description: A coloured band with a statement and up to two calls to action.
components.note: One band across the full width, two links and three tones from a select field. The second link disappears when it is empty.

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.instructions: Optional. A small line above the statement.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Statement
fields.instructions: One sentence that suggests an action.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.instructions: Optional. Two sentences at most.

fields.name: primary
fields.label: First link
fields.instructions: The more important of the two paths.

fields.name: secondary
fields.label: Second link
fields.instructions: Optional. Rendered as a quiet text link.

fields.name: tone
fields.label: Tone
fields.instructions: Three variants the theme's stylesheet can override.

components.title: FAQ
components.description: A question-and-answer list with an optional heading.
components.note: A repeater with two subfields, printed by the generic output: an accordion of details elements that works without JavaScript.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty if the component should start without a title.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Items
fields.instructions: One line per question.

components.title: Feature grid
components.description: Features in a grid: icon, title, text and an optional link per card.
components.note: A select field used as an icon choice: the editor picks from a list, so a typo cannot produce an icon that does not exist.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty if the grid should start without a title.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.instructions: Optional. One or two sentences above the grid.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Features
fields.instructions: One card per row. The order here is the order on the page.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.instructions: Rendered as a line icon, not as an image.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.instructions: Optional. Makes the card title clickable.

components.title: Hero
components.description: A page header with heading, subline and an optional call to action.
components.note: The minimum: a definition and nothing else. The plugin prints the fields generically, which is enough for a heading, a paragraph and a button.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.instructions: The main statement of the page.

fields.name: subline
fields.label: Subline
fields.instructions: Optional. One or two sentences that frame the heading.

fields.name: cta
fields.label: Call to action
fields.instructions: Optional. Link text and target in one field.

components.title: Movie
components.description: A film with poster, the hard facts in a definition list, cast and synopsis.
components.note: Facts as a definition list, the rating as a meter element with bounds, the running time written from a number of minutes. Empty fields drop out instead of leaving blank rows.

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Poster
fields.instructions: Portrait, at least 600 px tall. Without it, the text starts on the left.

fields.name: original_title
fields.label: Original title
fields.instructions: Only fill in if it differs from the original title.

fields.name: genre
fields.label: Genre
fields.instructions: Separate several with commas: drama, thriller.

fields.name: runtime
fields.label: Runtime in minutes
fields.instructions: The number only, 117 instead of 1:57. The view turns that into 1h 57m.

fields.name: rating
fields.label: Rating
fields.instructions: From 0 to 10, one decimal place: 8.4. Leave empty if there is none.

fields.name: cast
fields.label: Cast
fields.instructions: The order here is the order in the credits.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role
fields.instructions: Optional. Sits after the name as "as …".

fields.name: synopsis
fields.label: Synopsis
fields.instructions: Three to five sentences. No spoilers.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.instructions: Optional. Trailer, streaming or cinema.

components.title: Pricing
components.description: Plan cards with a feature list and one highlighted plan.
components.note: A repeater inside a repeater, plus exactly one highlighted tier — a rule that spans the rows, which is why it needs its own markup.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.instructions: Optional.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.instructions: Optional. For example a note on the term or net prices.

fields.name: plans
fields.label: Plans
fields.instructions: One plan per row. The features are a list of their own within each row.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price
fields.instructions: Number and currency, for example $89. No calculation, no formatting.

fields.name: period
fields.label: Period
fields.instructions: Optional. Sits small next to the price, for example / month.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.instructions: Optional. One sentence on who the plan is for.

fields.name: features
fields.label: Features
fields.instructions: One feature per row.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.instructions: Optional. Without a link the card ends after the feature list.

fields.name: highlight
fields.label: Highlight
fields.instructions: Highlights exactly one plan. Several highlighted plans highlight nothing.

components.title: Series
components.description: A series with seasons and episodes, poster and the details a series page needs.
components.note: Every season is a details element — collapsed, keyboard operable, no JavaScript. Season numbers come from the list order, the episode count is added up. The series is invented.

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Poster
fields.instructions: Portrait, at least 600 px tall.

fields.name: original_title
fields.label: Original title
fields.instructions: Only fill in if it differs from the original title.

fields.name: first_year
fields.label: First year
fields.instructions: Year of the first episode.

fields.name: last_year
fields.label: Last year
fields.instructions: Leave empty while the series is running. The view then writes "since" instead of a span.

fields.name: creator
fields.label: Idea
fields.instructions: Who invented the series, not who produced it.

fields.name: genre
fields.label: Genre
fields.instructions: Separate several with commas.

fields.name: rating
fields.label: Rating
fields.instructions: From 0 to 10, one decimal place.

fields.name: seasons
fields.label: Seasons
fields.instructions: One line per season; the order is the broadcast order.

fields.name: number
fields.label: Season
fields.instructions: The number the season runs under. Empty numbers them in sequence in the view.

fields.name: year
fields.label: Year
fields.instructions: Year this season first aired.

fields.name: episodes
fields.label: Episodes
fields.instructions: The order here is the broadcast order. The view assigns the episode number.

fields.name: synopsis
fields.label: What it is about
fields.instructions: Three to five sentences, no spoilers.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.instructions: Optional. Trailer or streaming.

components.title: Key figures
components.description: Three to four labelled numbers, marked up as a definition list.
components.note: A definition list instead of loose numbers: each figure keeps its label and an optional footnote.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.instructions: Optional. For screen readers the heading is the caption of the list.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Key figures
fields.instructions: One figure per row. Three or four read well; more gets tight.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.instructions: A number with a unit, for example 12 years or 98%.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Footnote
fields.instructions: Optional. For example when the figures were collected.

components.title: Testimonials
components.description: Testimonials as quote cards, scrollable sideways — without JavaScript.
components.note: Quotation semantics: blockquote, cite and an optional photo that simply drops out when empty.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.instructions: Optional.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Testimonials
fields.instructions: One quote per row. From two quotes on, the row can be swiped sideways.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.instructions: Without quotation marks — the output adds them.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role
fields.instructions: Optional. For example company and place.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photo
fields.instructions: Optional. Without a photo the card shows only the initials.

components.title: Record
components.description: An album with cover, release details and the full track list by side.
components.note: Two values nobody types: the track number comes from the row order, the total running time is added up — and only printed when every duration is readable.

fields.name: cover
fields.label: Cover
fields.instructions: Square image, at least 600 px. Without it, the text moves up.

fields.name: year
fields.label: Year
fields.instructions: Year of this release, not of the first publication.

fields.name: catalog
fields.label: Catalogue number
fields.instructions: Sits on the spine of the cover, often hyphenated: SHVL 804.

fields.name: tracks
fields.label: Tracks
fields.instructions: The order here is the order on the record. The view assigns the number; it is not maintained here.

fields.name: side
fields.label: Side
fields.instructions: Tracks on the same side sit together on the record.

fields.name: duration
fields.label: Length
fields.instructions: As m:ss, for example 3:42. Leave empty if unknown.
